items.text: Resort impecável, estava tudo limpo e organizado. As praias ao redor são lindas e tranquilas. Tem vários mercados, farmácias e restaurantes do lado do resort . Para quem quer conhecer Copacabana da em torno de 40m a 1h de carro, mas mesmo assim vale muito a pena. A Maria nos deu um atendimento excelente, respondia na hora e super atenciosa. Voltarei mais vezes.

Una estancia genial. La descripción y fotografías de la habitación son idénticas a lo que nos encontramos, y en general estuvimos muy a gusto. Charlie respondió veloz y eficazmente a cualquier cosilla que ibamos necesitando, y gozamos de un excelente trato, un buen rollito general y mucha privacidad pues estuvimos prácticamente solos en el piso durante nuestra estancia. Sin duda altamente recomendable, tanto por el piso en sí como por la ubicación, en pleno centro de Madrid. Un verdadero placer ;)

Gabriel es un gran anfitrión, muy dispuesto a ayudar, el departamento es exactamente cómo se ve en las fotos y es un gran lugar, muy tranquilo y con vecinos muy amables!  Repetiría mi estadía al volver a la cdmx!

Really enjoyed the time at Diana’s place. The house was nice and clean, just like in the photos. The pool was very nice. Also, we really liked the area as it was peaceful, nice and safe. Diana was a very welcoming and responsive host. Would definitely come here again.

Cozy and quiet room few minutes walk from downtown. We rented nearby city bikes to make it even quicker. We met Jim once during our 3 day stay, he was helpful and let us know of Meadows festival happening nearby. Online communication was detailed and helpful. there is also a nice restaurant and a pub just around the corner.

It was so nice to get picked up at the port and brought to my room which was very clean and spacious. There is a kitchen in the room and just up the steps a lovely terrace overlooking the port with another kitchen. It was a great place for morning coffee and late night appertivo. Great central location for your island adventures. Good Wi-Fi. Fresh water and coffee provided! I would definitely stay here again.

The apartment was great and amazing,  meet beyond my expectation. Communication with Sarina & Fiona was prompt as we was travelling  from Port Campbell and had a late check in.  The interior of the apartment was modern and was keep clean. Amenities was great - opposite was Williams Landing Shopping Centre, with Woolworths and Asian Grocery whereby we can get our fresh groceries daily.  The apartment is at great location- 11 min drive to Pacific Werribee Shopping Centre, 45 min to Melbourne Airport , 30 min to City and many more.  Thanks for hosting the lovely apartment and we will be back at Melbourne again.

Living in this building gives a true sense of life in central Paris, especially when it's hot and everyone keeps their windows open. You can hear everything the neighbors are doing, and you can infer that they can hear you. Still, you get used to it after a while and you don't even notice anymore.  The first thing I noticed about this building is that you need to pass two security doors with electronic keypad locks. Don't forget the access numbers! The apartment itself has a heavy mechanical locking mechanism as well. I felt very secure.  There is an elevator up to the apartment floor, but it is very small. I'm not sure if a wheelchair could fit inside it. I didn't try. Anyway, I was very glad for the elevator when transporting my luggage! Lugging suitcases up and down those curving stairs would have been an ordeal.  The apartment itself, once you get past the front door, is spotlessly clean and beautifully decorated. Exquisite Nepali carvings and antique furniture add a unique flavor to the traditional Parisian abode. I found it all very fascinating and an unexpected bonus.   The listing shows 1 1/2 bath facilities, but that isn't quite right. There's a toilet that feels l

This place was nice and clean. We loved staying here because of how close it was to pretty much everything in San Diego you would be traveling for. Would definitely stay here again when traveling to San Diego.

Javier was an EXCELLENT host. His team was incredibly responsive and accommodating. Javier provided us with an extensive listing of local food spots and bars to check out - all of which were home runs. He did not miss on a single one ! The apartment was great value and honestly the noise from outside is not bad at all. We felt completely safe the whole time and the Airbnb is in a great location. Close to a ton of good spots and easy to get to and from. Highly recommend Javier as a host - I believe he has several other properties which we are most definitely looking to checking out. Additionally Javier accommodated all of our requests! Including helping us out on the last day for a later check out / leaving bags with staff. 10/10 experience. Thanks Javier !

Wij hebben enorm genoten van de mooie AirBnB! Kristoffer reageerde altijd op eventuele vragen en was flexibel over de incheck tijden. Het appartement ligt in een leuke (maar niet al te toeristische) buurt. Zou het zeker aanraden! Mochten wij nog een keer Kopenhagen bezoeken, komen we zeker terug bij dit appartement!

We had a wonderful stay with Fabio at Le Guglie Bed and Breakfast.  Our room was clean, bright, and had A/C for warm nights if we needed it.  Fabio was extremely welcoming and easy going, giving us great suggestions for where to eat.   The boat taxi from the airport dropped us just around the corner from the B and B so it very easy to access.  This is really nice when you are carrying all of your luggage. All in all it was just what we needed to have a great few days in Venice.  We would definitely go there again if we get the chance to return to Venice.

Friendly host! Victor waited for us outside at the front of the door in the cold, when we experienced delay on the road. The house has everything that we needed. The location is in close proximity to the freeway that links to attractions. Ideal location if you are driving (:  Private parking is great! Just note that there are two flights of steps from the private parking if you have big bulky luggages.  The heater broke down during our stay but Victor is quick to response and get a repairman to get it fixed.
Great place great location close to everything staff was awesome and super helpful Prague is such a beutitful city !

It really was a hilltop nest! What a view! It was  an incredible place, in an incredible area! We had a wonderful stay, and Valéría was extremely responsive to all our queries. If we could have stayed for longer we would have but it was already booked up.

My fiancée and I stayed here for our first vacation together and it was perfect! The house itself was gorgeous and it had so much character. Every room was decorated beautifully. Our neighbors also kept minimum to no noise, which was great especially in the evening. The house was in a great location, no more than 15 minutes away from fantastic food, drinks, shopping, and more. The parking was great! We never had any issues with someone being in our spot in-front of the house. There were also a few games to choose from in the cabinets there which was thoughtful. My fiancée and I stayed up every night playing Scrabble!😁 It was an amazing house and we would definitely go to New Orleans and stay again.

La casa è più bella di quello che ci aspettavamo! Per la prima volta non ho trovato una ragnatela in tutta casa. Gli spazi sono ampi e siamo stati molto bene in 4 persone. Non mancava nulla. Cucina in perfette condizioni e bagno pulito. Letti abbastanza comodi x dormici tutta la settimana. Comodissimo lo spazio esterno.  Il giardino è spettacolare, con il cane anche molto apprezzato! Questa casa é la chiara dimostrazione che con oggetti e arredamenti umili ma ricercati in ogni dettaglio puoi rendere un ambiente familiare e accogliente. La zona è perfetta per visitare le coste più belle. A partire da Porto Cesareo fino a Santa Maria di Leuca. Da non perdere Punta della Suina che sarà il luogo di cui avrò maggiore nostalgia. Ma soprattutto godetevi la natura, l'imponente bellezza di ogni singolo lembo di terra salentina!

Great location, in driving distance to all local attractions, stunning beaches and walks. Lovely to return at the end of the day to relax in the privacy of the barn and play a few game's if pool.  Great host's on hand if you needed anything.
Overall good experience. Spacious and clean with nice decor. We had some trouble finding the unit due to the building layout, but the host was very responsive and helped us find it right away.

Roasaria's condo is great. It is located just off piazza Vecchia in Citta Alta, walikng distance to many shops and restaurants. The condo is very clean and nicely decorated. IWe would stay again next time we are in Bergamo. Tony & Larraine

Fantastic location - Yaletown is our favourite walk-about neighbourhood in downtown Vancouver.  Super clean unit, really well lit and trendily decorated.  Secure underground parking is great.  The unit was very well stocked - thank you for that.  Appliances are all new and top-of-the-line Bosch models! Kieran is a superstar host, first rate!  Very professional and welcoming with excellent response times to inquires.  We'll look for her properties in the future.  We had a fantastic stay!! Thanks Kieran!

Apartamento amplo e aconchegante. Apesar de não ser decorativo, mobília de primeira e com tudo que precisa para um bom descanso. Localização central dá acesso a todos os lados com facilidade, e a região tem opções de restaurantes a qualquer preço. Check in foi tranquilo e os anfitriões prestaram um serviço atencioso a todo momento. Mesmo sendo na área central, dormimos com janela aberta a todo momento, sem nos preocuparmos com ruídos excessivos. Com certeza será nossa primeira opção na próxima oportunidade ao voltar a SP. Obrigado aos anfitriões!

Location is perfect. Wonderful hype park is just 15 minutes walk you can run in the morning. Space is big and well preserved. This place has almost everything you need for stay. We stayed here more than one week. We could cook, laundry. I would highly recommend this place. The host provided everything we needed and everything went good thanks to their help and consideration. Wish I can visit this place again!

This immaculately appointed bnb was exceptional. I couldn't believe how lucky I was to find it. After a late attempt to get a room for the races I thought I might have missed out. Then found the air bnb site and this treasure. Obviously hosts Jennifer and Phil have done their homework and the result is this beautifully decorated apartment. With it's own private entry and located close to town it is a perfect choice for your stay in Warrnambool. Every possible need has been catered for including a comfortable bed and a strong shower which are both important to me. The apartment was spotless and also very spacious and the only regret was I was only here for one night.  My hosts could not have been more welcoming and Jennifer provided a delicious breakfast. If traveling to Warrnambool I would highly recommend this accommodation.

If we could give this host more stars, we absolutely would. Very communicative, lovely people. Checking in and out was easy, and the location was ideal- a nice short walk to the adorable main street. The property itself was awesome- felt like a mini Spanish villa. The hosts were the perfect mix, chatting it up with us a bit when we saw them but also very respectful of our privacy. We felt very comfortable staying there and very much hope the Bodega is open again for us to stay there next time we are in town!

Giuseppe's place was perfect. It was clean, he was fast to respond to any message, and the best part was the location. We were right in the middle of everything, walked everywhere from the coliseum to the Vatican easily. Next time I come to Rome I would stay here again!
Alex was great extremely helpful. Nice and always communicated. House was clean and in order. Great place to stay.

Fab place! It had everything we needed, was very clean and had a simple check in process meaning you can arrive at any time and know you’ll be in quickly and easily. Couldn’t fault it, and a very good location.

Apto bem estruturado e funcional, tudo novinho e completo! Primeira vez que fui ao Rj e a localização foi excelente, boa segurança, bem proximo da praia de Copacabana, com muitas opções de lazer pela região e transporte facil. O Anfitrião foi bem acessivel em todo o processo de reserva, check in e check out! Gostei bastante do apto e pretendo retornar! Super indico!

Ermanno nagyszerű házigazda, nagyon segítőkész volt és bármi kérdésem volt, mindig gyorsan válaszolt. A lakás nagyon kényelmes, tiszta és jól felszerelt, az elhelyezkedése pedig kíváló. Rengeteg látványosság sétatávolságon belül található, alig szálltunk tömegközlekedésre ottlétünk alatt. Ha egyszer visszamennék a városba, újra ezt a szállást választanám, és már egy másik Palermoba készülő ismerősömnek is ajánlottam ezt a helyet.

Very nice place, has elevator which for us was a great thing, the street has a lot of restaurants and local shops, the colosseum is perfectly walkable, the bathroom was very clean, hot water, everything was perfect. Thanks for everything Angelo.

This place was everything we wanted and more. Eric’s place was very close to everything whether it be walking or an affordable Uber ride. Check in was a breeze and everything was just as described and had a little extra - like New Orleans snacks and colorful beads to wear on Bourbon Street.  His instruction are clear and concise on what his expectations are. The location is quiet and in a cute little neighborhood. Everything was spotless and smelled amazing the minute we walked in. Thank you Eric, for allowing us to stay in your home. This will be the only place i will be booking whenever i return to the Big Easy once again.

This place is an oasis. We swam every day. We were joined in the pool area by Mr and Mrs Iguana (they stayed on the fence but added to the fun). The space is clean, comfortable, and close to everything at Lauderdale-By-The-Sea. Eddie and Liana have set this space up so each renter can feel like they have their own private villa in the midst of walkable activity and the beach. We are heading back to the west coast with memories, with comfort, and with a great picture from where we stayed. Thank you!

The experience was really nice! Matthieu is kind and helpful with great taste in decoration and music. Everything was set up nicely and we felt immediately at home. The appointment is spacious, full of light and has all the amenities. Its location perfect and convenient for commuting. Highly recommended :)

Perfect place with perfect design! The location was more than good, it is very close to the most of the sightseeings. It is very comfy inside and Erika is very friendly! The most beautiful apt throughout our trip in Italy. Erika, thanks a lot!
Daragh is a lovely host with a beautiful apartment. Daragh’s apartment is only a short walk from local restaurants and bars

Catherine's place was perfect for a trip to Dublin. The airbnb is quite spacious, and had everything that we needed. The location is great- walking distance to O'Connell street and Temple Bar and with a great view of the river. There are tons of great restaurants, shopping and local pubs in the area.  The apartment is also extremely close to the bus stops that will take you to/from the airport. Check-in and check-out was smooth, and Catherine graciously let us check-in early.

Sandra was a very good host; welcoming us late at night (after we had re-fuelled our stomachs in St Kilda!).... The studio is compact (everything you need); comfortable and cosy... A great location close to the beach (loved walking/jogging the beach walking-track); the bakery and the cafes nearby are excellent...... and also still convenient to "downtown" St Kilda and trams/buses to Melbourne... a nice place to be... relaxing and quiet.....

Great place. Small but new and very comfortable. Very very clean and a great location in the North part of the city. Very safe area, good security, good WiFi and TV. Has a washer/Dryer. Great for 1 person or a couple. Very nice and helpful  people to rent from. About 3 blocks from good restaurants and shopping. About a 5 minute taxi ride ( about $2-3 ) to Santa Fe Mall. Will defiantly stay there again.

The space is so much bigger and accessable friendly. The elevator is right next to the front door. When leaving you can take the elevator down from inside the property. The space is clean, modern, spacious, comfortable for a family of 5 or more. It's very luxurious and a great location. We didn't have to contact the host for any issues, and the easiest check out. So freshing to have a true super Airbnb host property. The amenities were excellent as well (patio, shower, full kitchen set up and water in the fridge).

Ein super Appartement mit einem sehr schönen Ausblick auf den Duero. Die Absprache zum Check-In verlief reibungslos und auch das Check-Out war unkompliziert, da wir die Schlüssel einfach in der Unterkunft lassen konnten und die Tür zugezogen haben. Igor hat uns pünktlich empfangen und uns sehr umfangreiche Tipps zu Sehenswürdigkeiten, Hotspots, Restaurants und schönen Straßen gegeben. Das Apartment war sehr sauber und von der Ausstattung her hat es uns an nichts gefehlt. Die Unterkunft liegt sehr zentral und relativ ruhig.  Danke für den angenehmen Aufenthalt.  Liebe Grüße Laura&Sören

Location, location, location! This apartment is in the most happening part of Taipei City with lots of restaurants, shops, and the MRT station just minutes away. There's even a Family Mart just downstairs, which makes getting midnight snacks easy. It is on the 5th floor and there's no elevator, so it's actually good for working off the snacks. The space is just like the photos; beautiful, clean, minimalistic, and it's actually more spacious than we expected. My husband and I stayed for a whole month and all the amenities we needed were provided. When we needed something, Ting and her husband were so kind to help us find it or even went out to get it for us. They also gave us some great suggestions on amazing places to eat and fun activities to do. The kitchenette is small but enough to make a meal or two, but you can easily find cheap eats just down the road anyway. The wifi is great and they recently upgraded their router. We stayed during spring and when it got a little chillier, they provided us with an extra heater and blanket. The balcony is a lovely spot for a morning coffee! Communication with them is great, they're very responsive. They also provided a handy guide on how to
Great location! Lovely place to stay, close to nature with lots of animals, such as kangaroos, horse, donkeys, chicken, cows.. We can see Cradle Mount from the backyard.
Lovely flat. Very clean and secure. Well appointed. Nicely situated near King's Cross. Paul was very responsive and flexible. We enjoyed our stay.

This location was perfect! So close to everything and the condo was so clean! I would for sure stay at this location again! Katherine was a pleasure to deal with and got back to me very quickly with any questions I had.

I really enjoyed my stay at Nathan’s place! I was there for several weeks and never had a problem. The apartment is clean, large (for a studio), and in an ideal location in Soho. Nathan was always quick to respond if I needed anything. Thank you!

The apartment is a thing of beauty. We loved the antique tiles, the brick wall, the wood - it was recently renovated with style, good taste, attention to detail. It is even better than pictures show, very bright and large. Salvador is a great host, he responds to any questions super quickly. Unfortunately we didn't get a chance to meet him in person.  We had a little issue, and he responded even at 1 am, and promptly solved it in a satisfactory way. The only caveat is that there is no heating system. I am sure most of the time it is not a problem, since Mexico City is a warm city, but we were there the first week of January, and it was really cold. That was a problem for us, because we like to hang our at home in the evening before dinner, and it was about 64F -18C at most. Not an issue for sleeping, since covers are provided. Noise can be a bit of an issue. The construction site next door starts at 7.30 am. I sleep through anything, but my husband got an unwelcome early start every morning. I am sure Salvador can't wait for them to be done with this project! Also, the terrace and big glass door/wall are awesome, but not soundproof at all. The upstairs neighbors where having a

My stay was not in the cottage I originally contracted for but Debora contacted me the day before my arrival to say that a slightly larger cottage was now available and would I like that for the same $ as she thought I’d be more comfortable. (Thank you, Debora!) It was everything I needed plus some. The bed was comfortable, the kitchen had the basics plus some thoughtful touches, and the bathroom had great towels. There was also a nice selection of soaps and lotions. Speaking of the bathroom, I’m not gonna lie. The shower is pretty small so if your idea of a romantic evening includes a friendly shower with your significant other, forget it. On the plus side, it’s more than enough room for solo bathing with PLENTY of HOT water and good pressure!❤️ (You can see where my priorities lie.) I had very little interaction with the hosts because everything was as it should be. The couple of times I had questions, the response was immediate. The neighborhood was quiet and felt safe. Recommended!

L'appartamento giusto per un soggiorno indimenticabile a Valencia. La vista dell'appartamento sui tetti di Valencia è impareggiabile, così come i dettagli di pregio della casa (maioliche e travi a vista). L'alloggio è dotato di tutto il necessario e accogliente. L'host è fantastico, risponde sempre e velocemente in modo gentile. Noi abbiamo avuto un piccolo problema con la chiave e si è adoperato subito per risolvere il problema. La zona della casa è molto carina, dotata di bar negozi e supermercati e  vicina al centro, comoda alla metro.
Grady is an excellent host. We came  in town to see the Eclipse which was amazing. The surroundings are beautiful and peaceful and we will be staying there again!
